description: This file defines the 'GeneralException' class, a custom exception for the OFBiz framework, supporting nested exceptions, message lists, and various constructors.

classes.name: GeneralException
classes.description: A custom exception class for OFBiz that supports nested exceptions, message lists, and various constructors for different use cases.

methods.name: checkException
methods.description: Static method to check and rethrow a Throwable as a GeneralException or its subclass.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the exception message, including nested exception message if present.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Returns the list of error messages associated with the exception.

methods.name: getNonNestedMessage
methods.description: Returns the message of this exception without nested exception message.

methods.name: getNested
methods.description: Returns the nested cause if present, otherwise returns this exception.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Prints the stack trace to standard error.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Prints the stack trace to a specified PrintStream.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Prints the stack trace to a specified PrintWriter.
